# Root cause analysis

## Status and summary

State whether the cause is confirmed and whether recovery is verified. Identify the incident, date, environment, and owner.

## Impact

Describe affected behavior and unaffected components. Mark unmeasured business impact or duration as unknown.

## Timeline and evidence

Include timestamped observations and changes. Separate original records from later interpretation.

## Failure mechanism

Explain the causal chain from trigger to symptom. Identify contributing conditions and evidence that rules out alternatives.

## Remediation and verification

Separate proposed mitigation, applied correction, and observed recovery. Include checks that exercise the affected path.

## Prevention and follow-up

List concrete actions, owners, and status. Do not invent deadlines or completion.
